review_method: Source-header and Git-history review, inspection of exact author archives, comparison of code-specific behavior, and Python AST comparisons for dd-CMA-ES. Headers and generic algorithmic similarities alone are not treated as proof of copying. The ten development-origin questions were subsequently resolved by maintainer Danial Yazdani's confirmation; dd-CMA-ES was explicitly excluded from public export.
